instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: NameCedar Booking Correction reviews traveler-name correction requests and updates active booking records when evidence and booking-provider permission are confirmed. Travelers submit requests with booking and name details, Booking Service Agents record evidence, Booking Provider Liaisons record permission and restrictions, Booking Records Officers update names after the required conditions are met, and Travel Correspondence Clerks send outcomes. Evidence types, permission criteria, and the delivery channel remain unresolved; booking cancellation and fare changes are excluded.

output.summary: NameCedar Booking Correction reviews traveler-name correction requests and controls updates to active booking records. Travelers provide correction details, Booking Service Agents record evidence, Booking Provider Liaisons record permission and restrictions, Booking Records Officers update names after the required conditions are met, and Travel Correspondence Clerks send outcomes. Evidence types, permission criteria, and the delivery channel remain unresolved, while booking cancellation and fare changes are excluded.
output.primary_goal: Review traveler-name correction requests and update active booking records when evidence and booking-provider permission are confirmed.
key_capabilities: Submit name-correction requests with booking and name information.
Update Traveler names after evidence and permission conditions are met.

The criteria for permitting name corrections are unresolved.
The delivery channel for name-correction outcomes is unresolved.
